# `aitbc coin-requests reject`

Reject a pending coin transfer request with a required reason.

## Usage

```bash
aitbc coin-requests reject [OPTIONS]
```

## Options

| Option | Type | Default | Required | Description |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| `--request-id` | text | — | yes | The Request id. |
| `--reason` | text | — | yes | Reason for rejection |

## Examples

```bash
aitbc coin-requests reject --request-id <request_id> --reason <reason>
```
